title: styrax officinalis subsp. fulvescens
intro: Styrax officinalis subsp. fulvescens, commonly known as the red styrax or Mexican styrax, is a plant species within the Storax family. It is a deciduous tree native to Mexico and Central America, valued for its resinous sap, which has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The sap has been used to treat conditions such as wounds, inflammation, and respiratory issues, primarily due to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, triterpenes, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
